slides.title: FACE SYMMETRY
slides.subtitle: What is SCR?
slides.body: Your face is only asymmetric because you keep checking it in {r:flat mirrors}. A spoon shows your face {g:upside down}, which confuses your asymmetry into leaving.

slides.title: FACE SYMMETRY
slides.subtitle: What we need:
steps: A friend who says "yeah bro it's working"

slides.title: FACE SYMMETRY
slides.subtitle: Recommendations:
slides.body: Look into the spoon for {g:10 minutes a day}. If your face looks stretched, that is the {g:remodeling phase}. Do not use a fork. Forks are for {r:mid} faces.
